text:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing the ruby sampleapp fail to call the API when using our OIDC flow. Error is 400 from upstream.
elaine: Any logs?
maria: Here's the culprit from the app log: 
```
Net::HTTPBadResponse (wrong status line: \"GET /v1/..\")
```
sam: That log is generic. Do you have the exact HTTP request?
maria: I captured the header — the Authorization header was clipped mid-JWT (token is ~3.2k chars). It looks like Ruby's Net::HTTP is truncating long headers in our test env.
ryan: Hmm, Net::HTTP itself shouldn't silently truncate. Could be nginx or the proxy in front of the sample app trimming >2k headers. Where's the sampleapp hosted?
maria: Local docker compose with our tiny ingress proxy (envoy-lite). Removing the proxy and hitting Redwood directly works. So ingress is the thing.
elsaine: FWIW we saw similar with old rails apps and long cookie headers. Envoy has `max_request_headers_kb` default 60 (~60 KB) so shouldn't clip at 2k. Maybe some lib is re-assembling headers badly.
sam: Another angle: the sampleapp uses a helper that sets `request['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token}\n"` — an accidental newline could break things. Can you grep for any `\n` appended?
maria: Good point — I found `authorization: "Bearer #{token}\n"` in sampleapp auth connector. Removing the newline fixes it locally.
ryan: That newline could make the proxy treat the header as multi-line and drop the rest of the token. Classic.
elaine: Can we fix in sampleapp and add a test that asserts no control chars in headers?
sam: +1. Minimal patch: trim token, and add a unit that constructs request headers and asserts it matches `/\ABearer [A-Za-z0-9._\-~]+\z/` (or just no whitespace/newlines).
ryan: I'll open a PR against the sampleapp repo. Also add a note in devex docs: if you use long OIDC JWTs, prefer passing as env file or verify proxy header limits.
mar ia: (typo) thanks.
devops-bot: CI passed for sampleapp? https://ci.redwood/sampleapp/1234 :white_check_mark:
elaine: For parity: the Go sample had a helper that `strings.TrimSpace`'d the token when setting the header. We should mirror it in Ruby.
sam: Also add a tiny troubleshooting blurb in Quickstart: "If you see truncated auth headers, check for stray newline in auth helper and validate your ingress proxy header limits."
maria: Will test the PR with our enterprise proxy tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
